eligibility_after_admission: carried within the episode; no repeated historical ST or 10% regime lookup
preserved_lifecycle: TRADE_LIFECYCLE_V1 and frozen seven-session Observation state rules
suspension: advances exchange-session age and prevents entry evaluation; pure suspension is not hard invalidation
hard_invalidation: explicit delisting, unsupported security class, invalid quote/constraint, known material regime change, or PIT/data conflict according to frozen lifecycle contracts
entry_evaluation: frozen Entry A and Entry B price/RSI predicates; no separate entry-date regime qualification
execution: no fill or position is inferred from an Entry signal
